# apple_game_center_matchmaking_queue (Resource)

Creates a Game Center matchmaking queue, which matches the players who ask for a match with a rule set, and optionally tries another rule set as an experiment. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_matchmaking_queue" "ranked" {
  reference_name = "ranked"
  rule_set_id    = apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set.ranked.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reference_name` (String) Name of the queue, which the game names in match requests. Changing it creates a new queue.
- `rule_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the rule set the queue matches with, e.g. `apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_set.example.id`.

### Optional

- `classic_matchmaking_bundle_ids` (Set of String) Bundle IDs of apps whose classic matchmaking requests go to this queue.
- `experiment_rule_set_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a rule set to try on part of the match requests.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking queue.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_matchmaking_queue.ranked
  identity = {
    id = "5b7d9f1a-3c2e-4d6b-8a0c-4e6f8a0b2c3d"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the matchmaking queue.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_matchmaking_queue.ranked 5b7d9f1a-3c2e-4d6b-8a0c-4e6f8a0b2c3d
```
